5.title: Annual Scientific Conference 2026
5.excerpt: The Thai Endodontic Association announces its Annual Scientific Conference 2026 on Dental Trauma and Root Resorption, on 30 November 2026 at Grande Centre Point Lumphini, Bangkok.
5.content:
The Thai Endodontic Association invites dentists and interested practitioners to its Annual Scientific Conference 2026 on the topic "Dental Trauma and Root Resorption: Guideline Updates and Clinical Management", covering the latest evidence-based approaches to dental injuries and root resorption — from diagnosis and treatment planning to long-term follow-up.

event DateMonday 30 November 2026
pin_drop VenueGrande Centre Point LumphiniBangkok, Thailand
workspace_premium Credit6 CDE units
groups SpeakersInternational speakerstogether with the Association's Country Speakers

Topics covered

  • Current classification and diagnosis of dental injuries per the latest international guidelines
  • Management of fractured and avulsed teeth and acute peri-radicular injuries
  • External and internal root resorption — detection, mechanisms and treatment selection
  • Follow-up strategies and retreatment decisions after complications

Attendees will receive real clinical case studies with Q&A sessions. Suitable for general practitioners, restorative dentists, endodontists and postgraduate students.
